mapper.select: SELECT c.cart_id, c.user_id, c.course_id, co.title, co.description, co.image, co.summary, co.price, u.nickname AS instructor_nickname FROM cart c JOIN courses co ON c.course_id = co.course_id JOIN instructors i ON co.instructor_id = i.instructor_id JOIN users u ON i.user_id = u.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
